variants.noveltyEN: Describe a mixed set without confusing some with none or all.

crossings.missionEN: Bento rolls up in a rainbow sail sled. The dock has a star flag and a moon flag.
crossings.setupEN: Bento waits at the near dock in one rainbow sail sled. A star flag and a moon flag are available beside a card: You need a star flag. The moon flag is optional.
crossings.setupAccessibleEN: Bento waits at the near dock in one rainbow sail sled. A star flag and a moon flag are available beside a card: You need a star flag. The moon flag is optional.

slots.goalEN: Distinguish the required flag from an optional addition.

variants.noveltyEN: Genuine meaning contrast: need identifies the required star; optional leaves the moon choice open.

clues.captionEN: A star flag and a moon flag stand beside a card reading: You need a star flag. The moon flag is optional. Bento waits in his sled at the dock with neither flag packed.
clues.accessibleEN: A star flag and a moon flag stand beside a card reading: You need a star flag. The moon flag is optional. Bento waits in his sled at the dock with neither flag packed.

variants.promptEN: What does the card let Bento do?

choices.textEN: Take the star flag and leave the moon flag.
choices.whyEN: The star is needed. The moon may be taken or left.

choices.textEN: Take the moon flag and leave the star flag.
choices.whyEN: The moon is optional, but the star is still needed.

variants.hintPTBR: Confira qual bandeira é necessária e qual fica por sua escolha.
variants.retryPTBR: Compare cada opção com a bandeira exigida pelo cartão.
variants.responseEN: Close the rule card. Bento remains at the dock; neither flag has yet been packed.
variants.confirmPTBR: Você identificou a bandeira necessária e a opcional.

variants.noveltyEN: Genuine meaning contrast: optional permits adding the moon while keeping the required star.

clues.captionEN: A star flag and a moon flag stand beside a card reading: You need a star flag. The moon flag is optional. Bento waits in his sled at the dock with neither flag packed.
clues.accessibleEN: A star flag and a moon flag stand beside a card reading: You need a star flag. The moon flag is optional. Bento waits in his sled at the dock with neither flag packed.

variants.promptEN: Which packing choice is also allowed by the card?

choices.textEN: Leave both flags on the dock.
choices.whyEN: The star is still needed, so Bento cannot leave both flags.

choices.textEN: Take both the star flag and the moon flag.
choices.whyEN: The moon is optional, so Bento may take it with the star.

variants.hintPTBR: Confira qual bandeira é necessária e qual fica por sua escolha.
variants.retryPTBR: Confira se cada opção mantém a bandeira exigida e respeita o que é opcional.
variants.responseEN: Close the rule card. Bento remains at the dock; neither flag has yet been packed.
variants.confirmPTBR: Você percebeu que a bandeira da lua pode acompanhar a estrela.

slots.goalEN: Check the packed star against the actual requirement.

variants.noveltyEN: Genuine meaning contrast: having the required star is enough; the moon remains optional.

clues.captionEN: The star flag is clipped to the sled sail. The moon flag stands on the dock. The card reads: You need a star flag. The moon flag is optional. Bento remains at the dock.
clues.accessibleEN: The star flag is clipped to the sled sail. The moon flag stands on the dock. The card reads: You need a star flag. The moon flag is optional. Bento remains at the dock.

variants.promptEN: Bento packed only the star flag. What's true?

choices.textEN: Bento has the flag he needs.
choices.whyEN: The star is the flag Bento needs.

choices.textEN: Bento still needs the moon flag.
choices.whyEN: The moon is optional, so Bento does not need it.

variants.hintPTBR: Confira a bandeira na vela e compare com a regra do cartão.
variants.retryPTBR: Compare a bandeira na vela com a que o cartão exige.
variants.responseEN: Close the packing card. The star flag stays clipped to the sail and the moon stays on the dock; Bento has not crossed.
variants.confirmPTBR: Você conferiu a bandeira na vela com a regra do cartão.

slots.goalEN: Report the chosen omission without inventing a prohibition.

variants.noveltyEN: Genuine meaning contrast: chose reports a decision; optional does not make leaving the moon mandatory.

clues.captionEN: A packing replay shows Bento clipping the star flag to his sail and leaving the moon flag on the dock. The card reads: You need a star flag. The moon flag is optional. The sled is still at the dock.
clues.accessibleEN: A packing replay shows Bento clipping the star flag to his sail and leaving the moon flag on the dock. The card reads: You need a star flag. The moon flag is optional. The sled is still at the dock.

variants.promptEN: Which line tells what happened without inventing a rule?

choices.textEN: Bento chose to leave the moon flag.
choices.whyEN: Bento chose to leave the moon; the card did not make him leave it.

choices.textEN: Bento had to leave the moon flag.
choices.whyEN: Optional means Bento could take the moon or leave it.

variants.hintPTBR: Confira se Bento escolheu ou se foi obrigado a deixar a lua.
variants.retryPTBR: Compare a ação de Bento com o que o cartão permite e exige.
variants.responseEN: Close the choice record. Bento zips across in the rainbow sail sled with the star flag, leaves a rainbow streak and joins gathering.c2.seat.02. The moon flag remains on the near dock. Commit reward.c2-02 once at logical landing on first clear; replay adds no arrival or reward.
variants.confirmPTBR: Você contou a escolha de Bento sem transformá-la em obrigação.

crossings.missionEN: Sol winds up a giant yellow duck boat. Two little boats drift in the lane.
crossings.setupEN: Sol waits at the near bank in one giant yellow wind-up duck boat. Two little boats drift in the lane. A readable note says: Only cross after both boats are at the dock.
crossings.setupAccessibleEN: Sol waits at the near bank in one giant yellow wind-up duck boat. Two little boats drift in the lane. A readable note says: Only cross after both boats are at the dock.

slots.goalEN: Identify the actual prerequisite for crossing.

variants.noveltyEN: Contrasts mechanical readiness with a condition that names both boats.

clues.captionEN: The wound-up duck wiggles its tail at the near bank. Both little boats are still afloat in the lane. The note reads: Only cross after both boats are at the dock. A separate WHAT IF picture shows one little boat tied at the dock and the other afloat.
clues.accessibleEN: The wound-up duck wiggles its tail at the near bank. Both little boats are still afloat in the lane. The note reads: Only cross after both boats are at the dock. A separate WHAT IF picture shows one little boat tied at the dock and the other afloat.

variants.promptEN: Does winding up the duck mean Sol can go?

choices.textEN: No, both boats still need to dock.
choices.whyEN: The duck's readiness does not replace the condition about both boats.

choices.textEN: Yes, the note says to go when the duck is ready.
choices.whyEN: The duck is ready, but the note's condition still has to be met.

variants.hintPTBR: Compare a condição do bilhete com a situação mostrada.
variants.retryPTBR: Releia o bilhete e confira se a condição já foi cumprida.
variants.responseEN: Close the condition card. Sol waits with the wound-up duck; both little boats remain afloat.
variants.confirmPTBR: Você comparou o pato pronto com a condição do bilhete.

variants.noveltyEN: Tests whether both applies to the pair rather than a single boat.

clues.captionEN: The wound-up duck wiggles its tail at the near bank. Both little boats are still afloat in the lane. The note reads: Only cross after both boats are at the dock. A separate WHAT IF picture shows one little boat tied at the dock and the other afloat.
clues.accessibleEN: The wound-up duck wiggles its tail at the near bank. Both little boats are still afloat in the lane. The note reads: Only cross after both boats are at the dock. A separate WHAT IF picture shows one little boat tied at the dock and the other afloat.

variants.promptEN: Would one docked boat satisfy the condition if the other were still in the lane?

choices.textEN: Yes, one docked boat is enough.
choices.whyEN: This treats one boat as enough even though the condition names both.

choices.textEN: No, the note requires both boats to be at the dock.
choices.whyEN: The condition covers both boats, so one docked boat leaves it incomplete.

variants.hintPTBR: Observe quantos barcos a condição menciona e compare com a hipótese.
variants.retryPTBR: Compare a hipótese com a exigência completa do bilhete.
variants.responseEN: Close the condition card. Sol waits with the wound-up duck; both little boats remain afloat.
variants.confirmPTBR: Você conferiu a condição para os dois barcos.

slots.goalEN: Recognize permission after docking without inventing urgency.

variants.noveltyEN: Distinguishes permission to act from a penalty invented by urgency.

clues.captionEN: Both little boats are tied in their dock spaces and the lane is clear. The note reads: Only cross after both boats are at the dock. A dock card reads: You may cross when the lane is clear. Sol waits in the duck boat at the near bank.
clues.accessibleEN: Both little boats are tied in their dock spaces and the lane is clear. The note reads: Only cross after both boats are at the dock. A dock card reads: You may cross when the lane is clear. Sol waits in the duck boat at the near bank.

variants.promptEN: What does the note let Sol do now?

choices.textEN: Cross now, or wait a little.
choices.whyEN: The note allows crossing or waiting; it says nothing about losing a turn.

choices.textEN: Cross now or lose her turn.
choices.whyEN: The note gives no deadline or penalty for waiting.

variants.hintPTBR: Compare o que o bilhete permite com o que ele exige.
variants.retryPTBR: Confira se esperar também continua sendo uma possibilidade.
variants.responseEN: Close the permission card. Both little boats stay tied at the dock; Sol may depart but has not yet crossed.
variants.confirmPTBR: Você identificou a permissão sem acrescentar urgência.

variants.noveltyEN: Contrasts may with must after the condition is met.

clues.captionEN: Both little boats are tied in their dock spaces and the lane is clear. The note reads: Only cross after both boats are at the dock. A dock card reads: You may cross when the lane is clear. Sol waits in the duck boat at the near bank.
clues.accessibleEN: Both little boats are tied in their dock spaces and the lane is clear. The note reads: Only cross after both boats are at the dock. A dock card reads: You may cross when the lane is clear. Sol waits in the duck boat at the near bank.

variants.promptEN: Which reminder keeps permission separate from an order?

choices.textEN: Sol must cross now because both boats have docked.
choices.whyEN: Must adds an obligation that the note does not give.

choices.textEN: Sol may cross now, but she can still choose to wait.
choices.whyEN: May expresses permission; must would turn it into an order.

variants.hintPTBR: Observe se a frase dá uma escolha ou uma ordem.
variants.retryPTBR: Releia o verbo e veja se ele indica escolha ou obrigação.
variants.responseEN: Close the permission card. Both little boats stay tied at the dock; Sol may depart but has not yet crossed.

slots.goalEN: Preserve completed docking before crossing in the preview report.

variants.noveltyEN: Contrasts once with while to preserve completed docking before crossing.

clues.captionEN: A CROSSING PREVIEW card has two numbered pictures. Picture 1 shows both little boats tied at the dock. Picture 2 shows Sol starting across in the duck boat while the little boats stay tied. The real duck boat is still at the near bank.
clues.accessibleEN: A CROSSING PREVIEW card has two numbered pictures. Picture 1 shows both little boats tied at the dock. Picture 2 shows Sol starting across in the duck boat while the little boats stay tied. The real duck boat is still at the near bank.

variants.promptEN: In the crossing preview, which line puts the events in the right order?

choices.textEN: Sol crossed once both boats had docked.
choices.whyEN: Once places docking before the crossing in the preview.

choices.textEN: Sol crossed while both boats were docking.
choices.whyEN: While makes docking and crossing happen at the same time, unlike the numbered scenes.

variants.hintPTBR: Compare a ordem dos quadros numerados no relato.
variants.retryPTBR: Confira se a primeira ação já terminou quando a segunda começa.

variants.confirmPTBR: Você manteve a ordem dos acontecimentos do relato.

crossings.missionEN: Fafá climbs onto a crescent-moon float with a dark lantern. Tiny paper boats wait in line.
crossings.setupEN: Fafá sits on one crescent-moon float at the near bank with a dark lantern. Tiny paper boats wait in a line. The moonwatch picnic has one empty lantern hook; earlier lights placed by the gathered helpers already shine.
crossings.setupAccessibleEN: Fafá sits on one crescent-moon float at the near bank with a dark lantern. Tiny paper boats wait in a line. The moonwatch picnic has one empty lantern hook; earlier lights placed by the gathered helpers already shine.

variants.noveltyEN: Use before with simple past to place an action earlier than a trip.

clues.accessibleEN: A two-picture record shows Fafá beside the same near-bank marker, first with a dark lantern and then with a lit lantern. Her float and the paper boats are still beside that marker.

variants.promptEN: Which line keeps the light and the trip in the right order?

choices.textEN: Fafá lit it before the trip began.

choices.textEN: Fafá lit it at the far bank.
choices.whyEN: The far bank is the destination, so this puts the lighting after the trip.

variants.responseEN: Close the timing record. The lantern remains lit at the near bank; the float has not left.
variants.confirmPTBR: Isso! Você observou a ordem dos acontecimentos.

slots.goalEN: Keep pulling agent and load distinct.

variants.noveltyEN: Keep the pulling agent separate from the object being pulled.

clues.captionEN: The paper boats are linked in a line ahead of the float. In a short towing demonstration beside the near-bank marker, the paper boats move forward, their rope tightens, and the float follows a short distance. The float remains beside the near bank.
clues.accessibleEN: The paper boats are linked in a line ahead of the float. In a short towing demonstration beside the near-bank marker, the paper boats move forward, their rope tightens, and the float follows a short distance. The float remains beside the near bank.

variants.promptEN: Which line makes it clear who pulls what?

choices.textEN: The paper boats pull Fafá’s float.
choices.whyEN: The paper boats are the ones pulling, and the float is what they pull.

variants.confirmPTBR: Isso! Você identificou quem puxa e o que é puxado.

slots.goalEN: Credit the final contribution without erasing earlier helpers.

variants.noveltyEN: Recognize a final contribution while preserving shared credit.

clues.captionEN: A FINALE PREVIEW card shows two numbered pictures. In picture 1 the group hangs lanterns, leaving one empty hook. In picture 2 Fafá hangs a lantern on that hook. All six gatherings glow in the second picture. The real Fafá and her lit lantern remain on the float at the near bank.
clues.accessibleEN: A FINALE PREVIEW card shows two numbered pictures. In picture 1 the group hangs lanterns, leaving one empty hook. In picture 2 Fafá hangs a lantern on that hook. All six gatherings glow in the second picture. The real Fafá and her lit lantern remain on the float at the near bank.

variants.promptEN: Which sign thanks Fafá without giving her all the credit?

choices.textEN: Fafá finished what we started.
choices.whyEN: This gives Fafá the final part while keeping the helpers’ earlier work.

choices.textEN: Fafá did it without us.
choices.whyEN: This says the helpers did not take part in the work.

variants.hintPTBR: Observe as luzes que já estavam no lugar e quem pendura a última.
